ComfyUI txt2img Upscaler 工作流程
我想分享我目前正在使用的工作流程。我还想知道是否有人可以给我有关改进工作流程的提示和技巧。由于预计 4x Upscaler 会变得流行，我喜欢展示它需要哪些节点。想知道您对参数设置有什么建议，欢迎评论区交流！

使用方法：下载zip文件并全部解压。

舒适UI/
└── 用户/
├── 默认
├── 工作流程
└── 4xZIT.json

现在您可以重新启动 comfyui 并在工作流程中找到它。
建议：使用dpmpp_2m_sde和模式类型线性会调整/修复你的图像
默认值：mode_type：“none”不会更改您的图像作为最终输出。

o.en:
ComfyUI txt2img Upscaler Workflow
I wanted to share the workflow I am currently using. Also would like to know if anyone can give me tips and tricks about improving my workflow.. as expecting the 4x Upscaler get bit popular, I liked to showcase which nodes it needs. would like to know if you have any suggestion over the parameter settings, let's meet in comment section!

How to use: download zip file and extract all.

ComfyUI/
└── user/
├── default
├── workflows
└── 4xZIT.json

now you can restart comfyui and find it in your workflows.
SUGGESTION: usingdpmpp_2m_sdeand mode typeLinearwilladjust/fixyour images
default: mode_type: "none" don't changes your image as final output.
